en.title: US Government Corruption Perception Hits 89%, a 20‑Year High
en.hook: US government corruption perception spikes to 89%, the highest in two decades, reflecting a growing crisis of public trust.
key_takeaways: Public trust in US government reaches a low, with 89% viewing it as corrupt—highest since 2005.
The surge reflects heightened scrutiny of political institutions amid recent scandals and legislative gridlock.
The finding underscores the urgent need for transparency reforms to restore citizen confidence.

zh.title: 美国政府腐败认知达89%，创20年新高
zh.hook: 美国政府腐败认知飙升至89%，创20年新高，凸显公众信任危机加剧
key_takeaways: 公众对美国政府的信任降至新低，89%的人认为政府腐败，为2005年以来的最高水平。
这一上升反映出公众对政治机构的高度关注，以及近期丑闻和立法僵局的影响。
该结果凸显了迫切需要实施透明度改革，以恢复公民信心。
